goal: Keep ledger accounts in a shared key-value store that reports read from too.

tasks.title: Key-value store interface
tasks.description: src/store.mjs exports createMemoryStore(): an object with get(key) (the stored value or undefined), put(key, value) and list(prefix = "") (the keys that start with prefix, sorted). Values are copied in and out (structuredClone), so callers never share objects with the store. Ledger and report build on this interface.
scenarios: Given an empty store When get("x") Then it returns undefined
Given put("k", {n: 1}) When get("k") Then it returns {n: 1}
Given a value was put and then the caller's object is mutated When get is called Then the stored value is unchanged; mutating a value returned by get does not change the store either
Given keys "b:1", "a:2", "a:1" When list("a:") Then it returns ["a:1", "a:2"]; list() returns all three sorted

tasks.title: Ledger keeps accounts in the store
tasks.description: new Ledger(store) keeps each account's balance in the store under "account:<id>" (a number of cents); with no argument it uses createMemoryStore(). open/deposit/balance keep their behaviour and errors. A second Ledger over the same store sees the same accounts and balances.
scenarios: Given a store When ledger 1 opens a and deposits 150 Then ledger 2 on the same store reports balance 150 for a
Given a store When account a is opened Then store.get("account:a") is 0
Given no store argument When a Ledger is created Then open/deposit/balance work as before
Given ledger 2 on the same store When it opens a again Then it throws (account exists)
changelog: the ledger keeps accounts in a store

tasks.title: Report totals from the store
tasks.description: report.totals(store) reads every "account:" key of the store and returns { accounts: <how many>, cents: <sum of balances> }. Other keys are ignored.
scenarios: Given a store with account:a = 100 and account:b = 50 When totals is called Then it returns { accounts: 2, cents: 150 }
Given an empty store When totals is called Then it returns { accounts: 0, cents: 0 }
Given a store that also holds "user:x" = 999 When totals is called Then that key is not counted
changelog: totals of all accounts in a store
